Title: Role Lifecycle — Delete Default Role + Substitute Custom Role Keeps Reps Detected
Preconditions: state from SR-ADM-001 (signed in as {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}). TEST_ENV=vcptcore. The default sales-rep role was seeded lazily with a random GUID id (nothing keys off the name 'sales-rep'). MANUAL / HIGH-RISK: deleting the default role is destructive to shared fixtures (8+ seeded reps hold it globally + per-org) and not cleanly reversible on a shared env — run only on a disposable/local env. The core hypothesis (detection by permission, not role id/name) is already substantiated by SR-ADM-009 (custom granting role offered) + SR-ADM-010 (re-point works).
Steps:
[NAV] Platform > Security > Roles > create a custom role granting sales-rep:access
[ACT] assign the custom role to a disposable rep (global + org)
[ACT] delete the default seeded sales-rep role
[ACT] open the "Sales Reps" app list
[ACT] open the create blade "Sales Rep role" dropdown
Cross_Layer_Checks: [API] rep detection and the role dropdown resolve by permission, so substituting the granting role does not break either {SPEC}
Failure_Signals: reps disappear from the list after the default role is deleted; the dropdown is empty; the default role is silently re-seeded, resurrecting a deleted role
Cleanup: Remove the custom role and restore the default granting role to baseline (disposable env only)
